description: Unit tests for the ActiveRequests class in the Rialto media server component, using Google Test framework. The tests cover ID management, segment addition/removal, and error handling.

classes.name: ActiveRequestsTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for ActiveRequests unit tests, inheriting from testing::Test.

methods.name: getTypeShouldReturnUnknownForInvalidId
methods.description: Test that getType returns UNKNOWN for an invalid ID.

methods.name: getSegmentsShouldThrowForInvalidId
methods.description: Test that getSegments throws an exception for an invalid ID.

methods.name: addSegmentShouldReturnFalseForNullSegment
methods.description: Test that addSegment returns ERROR when given a null segment.

methods.name: addSegmentShouldReturnErrorForInvalidData
methods.description: Test that addSegment returns ERROR for invalid data.

methods.name: addSegmentShouldReturnErrorForInvalidId
methods.description: Test that addSegment returns ERROR for an invalid ID.

methods.name: addSegmentsOverLimitShouldReturnNoSpace
methods.description: Test that adding segments over the limit returns NO_SPACE.

methods.name: shouldGenerateGetAndEraseIds
methods.description: Test ID generation, retrieval, and erasure.

methods.name: shouldClearIds
methods.description: Test clearing all IDs resets their types to UNKNOWN.

methods.name: shouldAddAndGetSegments
methods.description: Test adding a segment and retrieving it.

methods.name: shouldAddAndRemoveSegments
methods.description: Test adding segments and then clearing them, expecting exceptions on retrieval.
